01 — FAIL: meta refresh present, even with delay=0

Unlike the A-level meta-refresh-timing-absent rule (which allows delay="0" as an immediate redirect), this AAA-level rule flags ANY meta refresh regardless of delay. This is a whole-document check, so only one scenario is demonstrated here; the notApplicable case (no meta refresh tag at all) is covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file.
